"""Build a separate experimental corpus from independently addressed PDF regions.""" import argparse import json import re from copy import deepcopy from html import escape from pathlib import Path import pymupdf from occupational_fitness_rag.evaluation.comparison_corpus import verify_corpus from occupational_fitness_rag.ingestion.source_catalogue import extract_region from occupational_fitness_rag.provenance import digest, sha256_bytes, write_json def compose_unit(unit, segments): """Preserve the original criterion rectangle; address the full text by segments.""" if len({segment["segment_id"] for segment in segments}) != len(segments): raise ValueError("Duplicate source segment") result = deepcopy(unit) offset, mapped = 0, [] for segment in segments: text = segment["source_text"] if not text or sha256_bytes(text.encode("utf-8")) != segment["text_sha256"]: raise ValueError("Empty or changed original source segment") mapped.append({**deepcopy(segment), "composed_char_start": offset, "composed_char_end": offset + len(text)}) offset += len(text) + 2 criterion = [segment for segment in mapped if segment["segment_id"] == "canonical_criterion_cell"] if len(criterion) != 1 or criterion[0]["source_text"] != unit["evidence_text"] or criterion[0]["bbox"] != unit["bbox"]: raise ValueError("The original canonical criterion and rectangle must remain exact") text = "\n\n".join(segment["source_text"] for segment in mapped) result.update( evidence_text=text, source_text=text, text_sha256=sha256_bytes(text.encode("utf-8")), source_segments=mapped, segment_separator="\n\n", geometry_scope="bbox addresses the original criterion cell; source_segments address the complete composite", context_derivation={ "original_text_sha256": unit["text_sha256"] , "original_evidence_text": unit["evidence_text"], "original_bbox": deepcopy(unit["bbox"]), "context_kind": "original_condition_row_heading_and_commercial_column_heading", "private_standard_text_included": False, "clinical_review": "pending", "independent_human_review": "pending", }, ) # A duplicate rectangle that only covers the old cell cannot address the composite. if result.pop("alternate_regions", None): result["original_alternate_regions"] = deepcopy(unit["alternate_regions"]) return result def build(root, base_path, candidate_path, output): root, output = Path(root).resolve(), Path(output).resolve() base_path, candidate_path = Path(base_path).resolve(), Path(candidate_path).resolve() if not output.is_relative_to(root) or output == base_path.parent or output.is_relative_to(base_path.parent): raise ValueError("A context revision must use a separate project output directory") original_raw = base_path.read_bytes() original = json.loads(original_raw) verify_corpus(root, original) candidate_raw = candidate_path.read_bytes() candidate = json.loads(candidate_raw) expected_roles = { "row_heading": "condition_column_row_heading", "commercial_column_heading": "licence_column_heading", "canonical_criterion_cell": "commercial_column_conditional_criterion", } if ( candidate["target_source_id"] != "AFTD2022-DM-COM-008" or candidate["licence_scope"] != "commercial" or [segment["segment_id"] for segment in candidate["segments"]] != list(expected_roles) or any(segment["original_layout_role"] != expected_roles[segment["segment_id"]] for segment in candidate["segments"]) or candidate["segments"][0]["layout_normalized_text"] != "Insulin-treated diabetes (except gestational diabetes)" or candidate["segments"][1]["layout_normalized_text"] != "Commercial standards" ): raise ValueError("Expected the reviewed insulin-treated row and commercial column context") if candidate["existing_corpus_file_sha256"] != sha256_bytes(original_raw) or candidate["existing_corpus_sha256"] != original["corpus_sha256"]: raise ValueError("The proposed context belongs to another corpus") pdf = root / original["source_path"] if sha256_bytes(pdf.read_bytes()) != candidate["source_document_sha256"]: raise ValueError("Source PDF fingerprint differs") target_id = candidate["target_source_id"] target = next(unit for unit in original["units"] if unit["source_id"] == target_id) segments = [] with pymupdf.open(pdf) as document: for segment in candidate["segments"]: actual = extract_region(document[segment["pdf_page"] - 1], segment["bbox"]) expected = segment.get("source_text", segment.get("pdf_region_text", "")).strip() if actual != expected: raise ValueError("Proposed source segment differs from its actual PDF rectangle") segments.append({ "segment_id": segment["segment_id"], "role": segment["original_layout_role"], "source_text": actual, "text_sha256": sha256_bytes(actual.encode("utf-8")), "pdf_page": segment["pdf_page"], "printed_page": segment["printed_page"], "bbox": segment["bbox"], "source_document_sha256": original["document_sha256"], }) revised = compose_unit(target, segments) corpus = deepcopy(original) corpus["units"] = [revised if unit["source_id"] == target_id else unit for unit in corpus["units"]] canonical = {unit["source_id"]: unit for unit in corpus["units"] if "-EXP-" not in unit["source_id"]} changes = [] for unit in corpus["units"]: compact = re.sub(r"\s+", "", unit["evidence_text"]) previous = list(unit.get("covers_source_ids", [])) unit["covers_source_ids"] = sorted(sid for sid, source in canonical.items() if source["pdf_page"] == unit["pdf_page"] and re.sub(r"\s+", "", source["evidence_text"]) in compact) if previous != unit["covers_source_ids"]: changes.append({"source_id": unit["source_id"], "before": previous, "after": unit["covers_source_ids"]}) corpus.update( schema_version="1.1.0", context_review={ "base_corpus_sha256": original["corpus_sha256"], "base_corpus_file_sha256": sha256_bytes(original_raw), "candidate_sha256": sha256_bytes(candidate_raw), "changed_source_ids": [target_id], "original_pdf_regions_verified": True, "clinical_review": "pending", "independent_human_review": "pending", "production_change": False, "coverage_changes": changes, }, ) corpus.pop("corpus_sha256") corpus["corpus_sha256"] = digest(corpus) verify_corpus(root, corpus) if base_path.read_bytes() != original_raw or candidate_path.read_bytes() != candidate_raw: raise ValueError("Frozen inputs changed during context preparation") if output.exists() and any(output.iterdir()): raise ValueError("Preserve prior corpus revisions and use an empty output") output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) write_json(output / "corpus.json", corpus) write_json(output / "manifest.json", { "kind": "targeted_original_table_context_revision", "corpus_sha256": corpus["corpus_sha256"], "corpus_file_sha256": sha256_bytes((output / "corpus.json").read_bytes()), "builder_source": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8"), "context_review": corpus["context_review"], "unit_count": len(corpus["units"]), "canonical_source_count": len(canonical), "retrieval_calls": 0, "graph_indexes_built": 0, "active_in_production": False, "source_id": target_id, }) rows = "".join('' + escape(segment["segment_id"]) + '' + str(segment["pdf_page"]) + '' + escape(str(segment["bbox"])) + '
' + escape(segment["source_text"]) + '
' for segment in revised["source_segments"]) html = ('Original table context revision' 'OCCUPATIONAL FITNESS PLATFORM' '

Original table context revision

The insulin-treated diabetes row heading, including ' 'its gestational-diabetes exception, and the commercial column heading are retained as separate original PDF regions. ' 'The previous commercial criterion cell is unchanged. No private-standard criterion is included.

' '

This targeted engineering revision preserves 94 units and 28 canonical source IDs. Independent human and clinical ' 'review remain pending. No production catalogue or index is replaced, and no new retrieval is claimed.

' '' + rows + '
SegmentPDF pageOriginal rectangleExact source text

Revised corpus · Version and coverage changes

') (output / "index.html").write_text(html, encoding="utf-8") return {"units": len(corpus["units"]), "canonical_sources": len(canonical), "corpus_sha256": corpus["corpus_sha256"], "source_segments": len(segments), "coverage_changes": len(changes), "production_change": False} if __name__ == "__main__": parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__) parser.add_argument("--base", default="outputs/experiments/corpus_quality_v1/corpus.json") parser.add_argument("--candidate", default="outputs/experiments/source_scope_review_v1/context_candidate.json") parser.add_argument("--output", default="outputs/experiments/corpus_context_v2") args = parser.parse_args() print(json.dumps(build(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1], args.base, args.candidate, args.output), indent=2))
